name: qinqin extras
notice: Three further qinqin directions, each light and dark: Neon (ink-grey surfaces, neon accents), Pigments (Celadon and Indigo with the painter's accents 胭脂 rouge, 朱 vermilion, 藤黄 gamboge, 石绿 malachite, 群青 ultramarine and 紫 violet) and Pop (Bubblegum and Grape, tinted surfaces and clashing complementaries).
